metadata.title: Monitor Deployment
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Poll the CD pipeline run status until completion (terminal state or timeout). Monitors deployment stages sequentially based on target_environments order — if an earlier environment (e.g. QA) fails, later environments (e.g. SB) are not attempted. Reports progress and records final status per environment.

output.description: Deployment completion status with per-environment results

prerequisites: Trigger CD Pipeline step completed (cdPipelineRunId in memory)
specificActions: Get cdPipelineRunId and deployConfig.cd from memory
Poll pipeline status at intervals (cd.poll_interval_seconds, default 30s)
Monitor stages sequentially per target_environments order
If QA stage fails, SB stage is not attempted (sequential dependency)
Report progress at each poll (current stage, status, elapsed time)
Wait until pipeline reaches a terminal state (succeeded, failed, canceled) or timeout
tools: mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_build - Get pipeline build/run status and stage information
bestPractices: Respect the polling interval from config to avoid API rate limits
Track elapsed time from trigger to detect timeout before the pipeline does
Report progress so the user knows the deployment is active
Monitor stages in order — do not check SB status if QA has not completed
Distinguish between overall pipeline status and individual stage statuses
If the trigger step failed (cdTriggerStatus='failed'), skip monitoring and pass through to evaluate
Handle edge cases: pipeline queued but not started, pipeline stuck in progress

substeps.name: Get Run ID from Memory
substeps.description: Retrieve pipeline run ID and config for polling
actions: Read cdPipelineRunId from memory
Read deployConfig.cd for timeout_minutes, poll_interval_seconds, target_environments
If cdTriggerStatus is 'failed', skip to recording failure status and exit

substeps.name: Poll Pipeline Status
substeps.description: Repeatedly check pipeline status until terminal state
actions: Query pipeline run status via mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_build
Check if status is terminal: succeeded, failed, canceled
If still running, wait poll_interval_seconds before next check
Track elapsed time since trigger
If elapsed > timeout_minutes, set status to 'timeout'

substeps.name: Monitor Environment Stages
actions: For each environment in target_environments order:
Check the corresponding pipeline stage status
Record stage result (succeeded, failed, skipped, in-progress)
If QA stage fails, mark subsequent stages as 'not-attempted'
Report stage transitions as they occur

substeps.name: Report Progress
actions: At each poll interval, output current status:
Overall pipeline state, current stage, elapsed time, remaining timeout
Highlight stage transitions (e.g. 'QA: deploying -> succeeded')
Note any warnings or partial failures

substeps.name: Record Final Status
actions: Set cdPipelineStatus: succeeded, failed, canceled, or timeout
Set cdEnvironmentStatuses: object with per-environment status
Example: { "QA": "succeeded", "SB": "failed" }
Record total elapsed time and final pipeline details

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Get run ID from memory → Poll status at intervals → Monitor environment stages sequentially → Report progress → Record final status (succeeded/failed/canceled/timeout)

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: CD trigger results (cdPipelineRunId, cdTriggerStatus), deploy config (cd.timeout_minutes, cd.poll_interval_seconds, cd.target_environments)
fields: Information Produced: cdPipelineStatus (succeeded/failed/canceled/timeout), cdEnvironmentStatuses (per-environment status object, e.g. {"QA": "succeeded", "SB": "failed"})
Decisions Made: Timeout detection, sequential stage monitoring (stop on first failure)
